title: _validate_property is called before _ready
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1], v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf].

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7703) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600H with Radeon Graphics (12 threads) - 15.34 GiB memory

### Issue description

When adding a new node with a custom tool script which uses `get_parent` inside `_validate_property`, `get_parent` method returns `null` for the first time and then after node's `_ready` `_validate_property` is called for the second time with a correct `get_parent` result.

### Steps to reproduce

Make a tool script that extends from a `Node` and uses `get_parent` inside `_validate_property` (for example just prints the result from `get_parent`).
Then in the editor click "Add Child Node" in the context menu of the scene tree, select your custom script node and create it.
Observe the output panel - it will print `<Object#null>` first and then it will print your parent node info.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[_validate_property_order_2025-11-28_18-40-22.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23826330/_validate_property_order_2025-11-28_18-40-22.zip)
